decision_payload.feedback: REJECT R1-LAUNCH-002: reconcile_operations uses asyncio.gather without draining siblings after an uncaught project exception. A real malformed stored executor_receipt=[] raises AttributeError in LauncherOperations._validate_client_receipts, outside the per-project catch lists. Independent probe held one healthy project's to_thread worker while this corrupt project failed: 3 ticks launched 3 overlapping workers for the same healthy project, and the continuity thread exited on shutdown with all 3 workers still active. The batch future is therefore not a proof of quiescence; retry storms and resource teardown underneath live mutations are possible. Await every project task even when one fails (for example gather(return_exceptions=True) with observed failures), isolate unexpected project exceptions, and preserve actual worker completion rather than cancelling wrappers. Add a malformed/unexpected-project-failure regression with a held sibling: engine ticks continue, only one recovery batch remains in flight, and shutdown cannot complete until that sibling finishes. The previous starvation defect is fixed and all 8 isolation/lifespan tests passed, but this new exception path blocks approval.

evidence.scope: Disposable functions and threads; real receipt validator; no external services or source edits
